s: A company plans to migrate 600 on-premises servers, a mix of VMware VMs and physical servers, to AWS over 9 months. There is no up-to-date documentation of which servers communicate with each other. The migration team needs to group servers into applications and plan migration waves so that servers that depend on each other move together. Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Install the AWS Application Discovery Service Discovery Agent on the servers to collect process and network connection data. Use the network diagram in AWS Migration Hub to see the dependencies, group the servers into applications, and plan the waves.
Install the AWS Application Migration Service (AWS MGN) replication agent on all servers, launch test instances on AWS, and infer the dependencies from failed connections during testing.
Turn on VPC Flow Logs for the VPCs that will host the servers and analyze the flows with Amazon Athena to find the dependencies.
Use Migration Evaluator to collect inventory and utilization data, and use the business case report to group the servers into migration waves.

w.y: Wave planning needs dependency data. The Discovery Agent collects TCP connections (source and destination IP and port) and running processes from each server, VMware or physical, and Migration Hub uses that data to draw a network diagram and group servers into applications. Exam answer as written; for new customers AWS now points to AWS Transform for discovery, dependency mapping and wave planning, because Application Discovery Service and Migration Hub are closed to new customers.

o.A: Correct. The agent captures the server-to-server connections that dependency grouping needs, on both VMs and physical servers.
o.B: MGN replicates servers; it does not map dependencies. Finding them through broken test launches is slow and unreliable.
o.C: The servers are still on-premises, so there is no VPC traffic to log yet.
o.D: Migration Evaluator builds the financial business case (TCO, right-sizing, licensing). It does not map server-to-server dependencies.
